crossRefs.note: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the…
He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come…
“Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the…
I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of…
Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.
But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew on the fleece only, and it is dry on all the ground, then I’ll know that you will save Israel by my hand, as you have spoken.”
translations.bsb: then behold, I will place a fleece of wool on the threshing floor. If there is dew only on the fleece and all the ground is dry, then I will know that You are going to save Israel by my hand, as You have said.”
translations.kjv: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
translations.asv: behold, I will put a fleece of wool on the threshing-floor; if there be dew on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the ground, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by my hand, as thou hast spoken.
